name: Forge Room

features.name: Forge Workbench
features.description: A coordinator-first planning surface for task drafting, response review, conflict visibility, and synthesis preparation.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUiReady
commandSpecs.description: Signal that the Forge Room UI is attached and ready.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomCreateSession
commandSpecs.description: Create a new local Forge session.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateGoal
commandSpecs.description: Update the active goal draft for the current Forge session.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateOperatorProfile
commandSpecs.description: Persist the Forge operator profile for future runs.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateSessionContext
commandSpecs.description: Store the run-local selection of operator truths that should influence this Forge run.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateRunOverride
commandSpecs.description: Store run-local override values without mutating the persistent operator profile.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomRunPreflight
commandSpecs.description: Build or refresh the run-local preflight bundle.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomClearPreflight
commandSpecs.description: Remove the current run-local preflight result without changing run settings.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomGenerateDraft
commandSpecs.description: Generate a real draft breakdown from the active goal through the Architect seat.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomApplyDraftText
commandSpecs.description: Apply a manually edited draft breakdown payload to the active session.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpsertDraftTask
commandSpecs.description: Create or update a structured draft task without editing the raw JSON payload directly.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomRemoveDraftTask
commandSpecs.description: Remove a structured draft task and its checklist children from the current draft.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomApproveDraft
commandSpecs.description: Promote the current draft tasks into the approved task rail.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateApprovedTask
commandSpecs.description: Adjust dispatch settings for an approved task before queued assignments are sent.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateContextCapsule
commandSpecs.description: Update an approved task's advanced context capsule before dispatch starts.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomDispatchAssignments
commandSpecs.description: Dispatch queued approved tasks to their assigned seats and capture responses.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomGenerateSynthesis
commandSpecs.description: Generate a synthesis candidate from captured responses and grouped conflicts.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomSelectSynthesis
commandSpecs.description: Mark a synthesis as the selected export candidate.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomSaveSession
commandSpecs.description: Persist the active Forge session to room-local storage.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomLoadSession
commandSpecs.description: Load a selected Forge session from room-local storage.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomLoadLatestSession
commandSpecs.description: Load the most recently updated Forge session from room-local storage.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomDeleteSession
commandSpecs.description: Delete a saved Forge session from room-local storage.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomExportHandoffCheck
commandSpecs.description: Run the handoff export guard for the active Forge session.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomExportHandoff
commandSpecs.description: Export the selected synthesis into a target-room handoff package.

workbench.label: Forge Workbench
workbench.description: A room-local orchestration workbench for goal planning, review, synthesis, and handoff.

description: A guided production workbench where goals are shaped into tasks, compared across AI roles, and prepared for downstream handoff.
